mapper.select: SELECT p.tenant_id,p.project_id,p.policy_revision,p.fixed_json,p.request_json,p.request_sha256,p.content_sha256,p.operation_id,p.idempotency_key,p.created_by,DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,p.classification,p.schema_version,p.schema_manifest_sha256,p.audit_id,p.event_id,p.receipt_json,p.session_id,p.context_json FROM runtime_retention_policy p WHERE p.policy_revision=#{policyRevision} LIMIT 2

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.project_id,p.policy_revision,p.fixed_json,p.request_json,p.request_sha256,p.content_sha256,p.operation_id,p.idempotency_key,p.created_by,DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,p.classification,p.schema_version,p.schema_manifest_sha256,p.audit_id,p.event_id,p.receipt_json,p.session_id,p.context_json FROM runtime_retention_policy p WHERE p.created_by=#{userId} AND p.idempotency_key=#{key} LIMIT 2

SELECT policy_revision FROM runtime_retention_policy WHERE (project_id IS NULL OR project_id=#{projectId}) AND classification=#{classification} AND effective_from <= #{now} AND effective_until > #{now} ORDER BY policy_revision LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT content_sha256 FROM version_registry WHERE version_id=#{policyRevision} AND owner_project_id <=> #{projectId} AND entity_kind='RUNTIME_RETENTION_POLICY' LIMIT 2

SELECT response_ref FROM operation_record WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{creator} AND created_by=#{creator} AND operation_name='RUNTIME-RETENTION-APPROVE' AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND target_id=#{policyRevision} AND state='COMPLETED' AND http_status=201 AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND subject_id=#{creator} AND created_by=#{creator} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action='runtime.retention.approved' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{policyRevision} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='runtime.retention.approved' LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,policy_revision,IF(retired_at IS NULL,NULL,DATE_FORMAT(retired_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) AS retired_at,decision_id,CAST(revision AS CHAR) AS revision,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification,created_by,IF(created_at IS NULL,NULL,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) AS created_at,IF(updated_at IS NULL,NULL,DATE_FORMAT(updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) AS updated_at FROM runtime_retention_state WHERE policy_revision=#{policyRevision} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,decision_id,policy_revision,fixed_json,content_sha256,operation_id,idempotency_key,created_by,IF(created_at IS NULL,NULL,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) AS created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification FROM runtime_retention_retirement WHERE decision_id=#{decisionId} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,decision_id,policy_revision,fixed_json,content_sha256,operation_id,idempotency_key,created_by,IF(created_at IS NULL,NULL,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) AS created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification FROM runtime_retention_retirement WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND decision_kind='DISABLE' LIMIT 2
mapper.update: UPDATE runtime_retention_state SET retired_at=#{effectiveAt},decision_id=#{decisionId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE policy_revision=#{policyRevision} AND revision=#{expected} AND retired_at IS NULL AND decision_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT response_ref FROM operation_record WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{creator} AND created_by=#{creator} AND operation_name=#{operationName} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND target_id=#{operationTarget} AND state='COMPLETED' AND http_status=#{httpStatus} AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND subject_id=#{creator} AND created_by=#{creator} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action='runtime.retention.retired' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=(SELECT policy_revision FROM runtime_retention_retirement WHERE decision_id=#{decisionId}) AND aggregate_revision=2 AND event_type='runtime.retention.retired' LIMIT 2

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.project_id,p.policy_revision,p.fixed_json,p.request_json,p.request_sha256,p.content_sha256,p.operation_id,p.idempotency_key,p.created_by,DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,p.classification,p.schema_version,p.schema_manifest_sha256,p.audit_id,p.event_id,p.receipt_json,p.session_id,p.context_json FROM runtime_retention_policy p WHERE p.project_id <=> #{projectId} AND p.policy_revision > #{after} ORDER BY p.policy_revision LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,cancellation_id,fixed_json,content_sha256,operation_id,cancel_key,original_kind,original_key,original_sha256,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,classification,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM runtime_retention_cancellation WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND original_kind=#{originalKind} AND original_key=#{originalKey} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,cancellation_id,fixed_json,content_sha256,operation_id,cancel_key,original_kind,original_key,original_sha256,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,classification,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM runtime_retention_cancellation WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND cancel_key=#{key} LIMIT 2

SELECT response_ref FROM operation_record WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND operation_name='RUNTIME-RETENTION-CANCEL' AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND target_id=#{cancellationId} AND state='COMPLETED' AND http_status=200 AND revision=1 AND error_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action='runtime.retention.request.cancelled' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{cancellationId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='runtime.retention.request.cancelled' LIMIT 2
